content_fields.title: Generate secure access tokens (API tokens)
content_fields.description: Generate token-signing material from a cryptographic source, or require it from configuration, never from `random`.
content_fields.finding: The fallback signing secret is six decimal digits drawn from the non-cryptographic `random` module.
content_fields.required_fix:
# app/config.py
# generate_random_secret() is deleted; the key must be supplied:
JWT_SECRET_KEY: str = _required("JWT_SECRET_KEY")

# If a value must ever be generated operationally, it is done out of band:
#   python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(48))"
criteria: `random` is not used for any token or key.
Generated tokens carry at least 256 bits of entropy.
The application never invents a signing key at runtime.
